text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One important task is image recognition, where a computer can identify what is in a picture, such as a person, an animal, or an object. Another key task is object detection, which means finding and locating multiple objects in an image at the same time. Computer vision has many useful applications in everyday life. For example, it is used in security cameras, medical imaging, and shopping apps. One of the most exciting uses is in self-driving cars, where computer vision helps the vehicle recognize roads, traffic signs, and pedestrians to drive safely.
